parameters.content:
STEP 5
POST /webhook/interview/answer
Body: { sessionId, answer, audioUrl? }
Scores the answer, then DECIDES: probe deeper (adaptive follow-up)
or advance. Session state lives in interview_sessions.state.

VOICE SEAM: STT fills `answer` inbound; response.voice.speak is what TTS reads.

parameters.jsCode:
const b = $('Webhook').first().json.body || {};
return [{ json: { userId: $json.id, sessionId: b.sessionId, answer: b.answer, audioUrl: b.audioUrl || null } }];

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  user_id: $('Resolve current question').first().json.userId,
  session_id: $('Resolve current question').first().json.session.id,
  answer_id: $json[0].id,
  score: $('LLM: score_answer').first().json.data.score,
  competencies_assessed: $('LLM: score_answer').first().json.data.competencies_assessed || [],
  strengths: $('LLM: score_answer').first().json.data.strengths || [],
  improvements: $('LLM: score_answer').first().json.data.improvements || [],
  rewrite_hint: $('LLM: score_answer').first().json.data.rewrite_hint,
  follow_up: $('LLM: score_answer').first().json.data.follow_up,
  next_action: $('LLM: score_answer').first().json.data.next_action
}) }}

parameters.url: ={{ $env.SUPABASE_URL }}/rest/v1/questions?id=eq.{{ $('Decide next + update state').first().json.qIds ? $('Decide next + update state').first().json.nextIndex : 0 }}
